First public build of the native Android client for Frigate NVR.

## What it does
- Sign in to your Frigate server and stay signed in: the session is renewed
  from the stored credentials, so the password is typed once.
- Live: the camera grid, a camera view with fullscreen, picture-in-picture,
  pinch zoom, activity, and sound.
- History: the recordings of a camera with a timeline and playback.
- Events: the review list with preview, filters, marking as reviewed, export,
  and the motion regions.
- Settings: the server details and the account, with a view mode and an edit mode.

## Home and away addresses
- A server has a main address (https, works from anywhere) and an optional
  home address (http is allowed) with a list of home Wi-Fi networks.
- On a listed network the app uses the home address; on mobile data, on any
  other Wi-Fi, without the location permission, or when the home address does
  not answer, it uses the main one.
- Android shows the Wi-Fi name only with the location permission; without it
  the main address is always used.
- The main address can be changed in Settings. Changing it signs you out:
  sign in again at the new address.

## Install
Download the APK below. To update an installed build use `adb install -r`;
do not uninstall the app, that erases the session and the saved credentials.

Requires Android 12 (API 31) or newer, arm64-v8a or armeabi-v7a.
